question: Does the released EMA/HOLD transform on sealed raw model predictions and source market returns reproduce the exact f696 frozen_current target on all 944 signal dates, and how much of the cash difference occurs at EMA versus HOLD?

method.source: inputs/raw_predictions['frozen_current'], inputs/source_targets['frozen_current'], inputs/market aligned by 944 signal dates
method.replay: Use sealed parent smoothing_span and rebalance_threshold, sealed outer_refit candidate, and exact src.workflow.pit_constituent_auxiliary_training_allocation._smooth_weights with source-market SOXL/SOXX returns
method.identity_gate: All five replayed outputs equal source_targets and f696 frame within max absolute 1e-7 on all 944 dates
method.decomposition: For each asset weight, report raw-to-EMA and EMA-to-accepted mean/max absolute differences, plus the count of accepted days differing from EMA as a lower bound on HOLD. No new policy or account.
method.causal_clock: Current-day source returns update virtual gross marked holdings only after the current target is accepted; a fixed first-day return perturbation must leave target day 1 unchanged. No inference that current return was known at the current decision.

scientific_boundary: The transform is a source-target lineage, not an economic improvement. If parity fails, stop and record the exact dependency. If it passes, any factor sensitivity test must include this transform and be separately frozen.
